- Marissa: send onboarding checklist and share POC template (attached).

- Naomi (CS): schedule 60-min onboarding + infra review once we have dataset/access.

If anything above is off, call it out. Otherwise, can you confirm dataset share and which kickoff slot works?

Thanks — looking forward to getting your team up and running.
